goal: Prevent the merged-worktree reaper from deleting clean worktrees whose branches contain unpushed commits or have no upstream, while preserving safe cleanup behavior.
worker: codex forked repo-maintenance agent for issue 2624
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, or shared-cloud mutation
No modification or deletion of unrelated worktrees
assumptions: The implementation commit was created locally before this contract because the new PR contract requirement was discovered after dispatch; the remote branch remained absent and no PR or external mutation occurred.
A non-zero upstream..HEAD count means the branch has local-only commits and must be kept.
A branch without an upstream must be kept.
stop_conditions: The implementation requires a path outside this contract
Any test shows existing safe cleanup behavior was weakened
The remote branch exists before the immutable contract is published
Any operation would delete or mutate a worktree
